name: Localization
description: Locale reference DATA — ISO languages, countries and currencies with their relationships (country ↔ languages ↔ currency), timezones, date/time formats, flag artwork, and the flag-aware pickers over them. Single source of truth, entering through one swappable data seam (server/localization.source). The translation runtime is a separate module: `i18n`.
author: Kuray Karaaslan
